description.v: j2gha-local: true lists and checks only, builds nothing
j2gha-local: release version named in the manifest commit

value.v: "file://${env.WORKSPACE}/.gitlab/"  // j2gha-local: the internal GitLab is unreachable; local repositories created in Get Repos stand in for it
App Branch Close and Tag (not currently integrated)

args.v: "git init -q -b master ${env.WORKSPACE}/.gitlab/${repos[i][1]}.git && cd ${env.WORKSPACE}/.gitlab/${repos[i][1]}.git && n=28 && for t in v1.0.0 v1.0.1; do n=\$((n+1)) && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2018-03-\${n}T12:00:00 GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2018-03-\${n}T12:00:00 git -c user.name=j2gha -c user.email=j2gha@localhost commit -q --allow-empty -m \$t && git tag \$t; done"  // j2gha-local: stand-in for the GitLab repository: two tagged commits a day apart (rev-list orders by commit date), so the git describe commands below work unchanged
